name: Babysitter
source:
You play a freelance programmer, whose career is not as successful as expected. Currently you are desperately seeking for a client, who would buy the "special software" you have been working on for a while, and you hope it will make you filthy rich. In the meantime, your sister is having an argument with her daughter whether she will go to college or not. This argument ends in having your niece living in your apartment's free room, while she is looking for a job, instead of going to college, in order to be independent...

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/T4bbo]Patreon[/url]]
